ocr_text:
Note 11 — Concentration of Credit Risk:

The Company primarily maintains its cash and security balances at three financial institutions.
Accounts are insured by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) and the Securities
investor Protection Corporation (SIPC). Balances have exceeded FDIC and SIPC insured limits in
2012.

The Company is engaged in various trading and brokerage activities in which counterparties
primarily include banks, clearing organizations, and other financial institutions. In the event
counterparties do not fulfill their obligations, the Company may be exposed to risk. The risk of default
depends on the creditworthiness of the counterparty or issuer of the instrument. It is the Company's
policy to review, as necessary, the credit standing of each counterparty.
